about: MUTATING — fast-forwards an instance's tenant main, which is what seed-tenant.sh publishes into the live registries at every services-container start. Asked for by David 2026-09-22 (backlog 01d3a701) in the shape of design 17835005 (decided by David 2026-09-21 — a rendered plan hash, signed with his passkey, single-use, verified before the argv is built), and authorised per run by that passkey. It declares requires_approval and names plan-a-tenant-merge as its plan_verb, so the runner renders the plan (from the same instance and merge_branch) onto the request's approve step, runs this only after a passkey signs it (a presence stamp bound to the plan bytes, under ten minutes old, single-use), and hands the script sha256 of the SIGNED plan as plan_sha256 (backlog fd7090cc). Its bound is by construction of the ONE script it calls (infra/forge/merge-tenant-main.sh): the repo and branch are the instance's own tenant_repo / tenant_ref from infra/cluster/instances.toml, never a parameter; it re-renders the plan and refuses unless the bytes still hash to the approved plan_sha256, so a main, a branch, a resolution or a check verdict that moved since the approval lands nothing; the one push is the merge commit the plan names, a fast-forward by the ancestry the plan checked, carrying --force-with-lease on the main sha the plan names; and main is read back afterwards.
